task: Write an Alembic migration that groups assistant_project_mapping rows by project into ms_teams Settings rows, then drops the assistant_project_mapping table.

key_reasoning.reason: No precedent in this repo for a single migration that both aggregates rows via group-by and drops the source table; the drop is irreversible for the original per-mapping granularity even with a compensating downgrade, and there is no existing test for the transform or its interaction with Settings.check_ms_teams_singleton/validate_ms_teams_request. Two red flags apply additively: 'changes database schema significantly' (dropping assistant_project_mapping, removing its FK/unique constraint/index) and 'requires data migration' (grouping many mapping rows into one Settings row per project), each bumping technical_risk by 1 from an L(4) baseline to the XXL(6) cap.

The destination shape is fully specified by Story 1's merged validator/model (one Settings row per project, credential_type=ms_teams, one assistant_ids credential_values entry), which removes most design ambiguity, but the group-by transform itself has no direct precedent and the task explicitly leaves unhandled the edge case of a project that already has an ms_teams Settings row before the migration runs.

Baseline is a single new migration file under src/external/alembic/versions/ (S), possibly plus one migration-logic test file per the k5l6m7n8o9p0 precedent; bumped to M by the 'requires data migration' red flag.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: 'Changes database schema significantly' (drops assistant_project_mapping table and its FK/unique constraint/index)
Technical Risk bumped from XL to XXL (capped): 'Requires data migration' (grouping assistant_project_mapping rows by project into aggregated Settings rows)
Affected Layers bumped from XS to S: 'Changes database schema significantly'
File Change Estimate bumped from S to M: 'Requires data migration'
